replaces_for_baskets: frontend/contract.json stays the single-item screen guide. This file is the basket contract.

person_4.shipping: HK$30 when the combined subtotal is under HK$400, free at HK$400. One fee for the whole cart.

cart.ignored: A top-level merchant field. Each line keeps the merchant stored on the product.

pay.caller: person 1, only after policy PASS or an approved escalation

still_needed: Add sell_point to the product model and return it from GET /products and GET /products/{sku}.
Accept payment_route on POST /cart and return discount plus the reduced total_landed_cost. Until then person 1 does not subtract a promo from the amount it sends to POST /pay.

person_3.render_lines_when: lines is non-empty. One row per line, with product_reason and merchant_reason.
person_3.render_question_when: status == NEEDS_INPUT. Do not show a paid order and do not start the approval timer.
person_3.reply: Send the shopper's answer as a new intent. The agent does not yet apply 'make the swap' or 'send for approval'.
person_3.audit: Show every BASKET_PICKED, POLICY_CHECK, and BASKET_REVISED, in index order. POLICY_CHECK.result and HALTED.result are the policy engine snapshot. They are not part of the hash.

action_plan_fields.lines: Chosen products. Empty on a one-product run.
action_plan_fields.repairs: Swaps already made so the basket could fit.
action_plan_fields.payment_route: The route person 1 chose. Person 4 echoes it on POST /pay.
action_plan_fields.payment_reason: Why that route. Estimated promo savings are not subtracted from quote.total_landed_cost.
action_plan_fields.question: Empty unless status is NEEDS_INPUT.
action_plan_fields.reply: What the shopper should read. When some categories are blacklisted, this says so. lines, quote, and payment are only the items that can still be paid.
action_plan_fields.react: ReAct trace in order. Each step has thought, action, observation, and source. source llm is the model. source agent is a tool step. source catalog means code built the needs without the model.
action_plan_fields.policy: The last policy result. Earlier results are in audit_log.
action_plan_fields.audit_log.result: On POLICY_CHECK and HALTED, the engine snapshot: status, rule, reason, amount, currency, monthly_spent, monthly_remaining, per_transaction_cap, monthly_cap, bulk_ceiling. Omitted from the hash.
action_plan_fields.quote.total_landed_cost: The number person 2 judged and the number person 4 is asked to charge.

cases.intent: cheap toilet paper and a cheap food container

cases.note: The live shelf has one product per sell point per category, so this case uses a stand-in catalog. Person 4 can make it real by stocking two merchants for one sell point.

cases.intent: cheap toilet paper and 2 best rated shampoo
cheap toilet paper and everyday rice
one cheap item from every category

expect.audit: One policy check per line, then one check of the landed total. Every category is allowed.

cases.intent: one cheap item from every category, same merchant

expect.reply: Code compared the shops and locked the basket to HKTVmall. The landed total is over HK$500, so the agent asks before paying.

person_2: Accept lines on POST /check_policy: merchant, category, sku, qty, and line_total on each line, plus amount as the landed total. Judge merchant and category per line, and the HK$500 / HK$800 / HK$2000 caps on amount.

Until that body exists, person 1 sends one check per line and one check for the total. The total call uses the only merchant when every line shares one, otherwise the first line's merchant, and a blank category when the lines differ. Your category list still runs on the line calls.
Do not choose a SKU or a payment route.
Keep logging approval, refusal, and expiry. Person 1 logs every POLICY_CHECK it tried, including the baskets that lose, plus BASKET_REVISED when a line moves.
person_3: Read this file. Render lines, both reasons, payment_route, and payment_reason.
On NEEDS_INPUT, show question and wait. Do not open the 10-minute approval from that status.

Show reply when it is set. A blacklist reply means those categories were left out. A same-merchant reply names the shop the agent picked and the coverage of the other shops. lines, quote, and payment are the items that are ready to pay.
Render react in order as Thought, Action, Observation. Keep the source label. llm is the model trace. agent is the tool that actually ran.
Show the whole audit, not only the last POLICY_CHECK. Render audit_log.result on each POLICY_CHECK and on HALTED. Render BASKET_PICKED.thought so the shopper can see why each line was chosen.
A later intent can carry the shopper's choice. Person 1 does not yet turn 'make the swap' or 'send for approval' into a new basket.
person_4: Keep several merchants in one POST /cart. Shipping stays one fee on the combined subtotal unless you change it; if you do, total_landed_cost is still the only number person 1 will check and pay.
POST /pay charges cart_total on the payment_route person 1 sends. You do not pick the card. You receive nothing from person 2.
Add sell_point to Product and return it.
Next step, not required for the current agent: POST /cart takes payment_route and returns the discount and the reduced total. Person 1 will keep charging the unreduced total until that exists.
One request, one charge. Split tender is outside this contract.
